# Apps by Bison

> Eight apps for drawing, vector design, comics, ebooks, personal video libraries, retro games, your own music and custom keyboards. Explore their features, requirements and official download links.

## Authorship and naming

These are guides and product information from Bison, the developer of the listed apps; they are not independent reviews or rankings.
Markdown is another representation of the same HTML content. Read feature limits, source attributions and version notes in the linked page. English pages are translations of the Chinese originals.
Internal keys come from the site product catalogs; they are content-association identifiers, not alternative store product names. Product names and store identities are documented by the app pages and their official App Store links.
[Chinese product data](https://github.com/AllLuckly/AllLuckly.github.io/blob/master/_data/apps.yml) · [English product data](https://github.com/AllLuckly/AllLuckly.github.io/blob/master/_data/apps_en.yml)

## Applications

- [Aquarell: Watercolour Drawing for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/aquarell/index.md): Draw on iPhone and iPad with Aquarell brushes, layers and palettes. Follow a beginner tutorial, then save a PNG, JPEG, layered PSD or native project. Product: Aquarell; internal content key: `pastel`; catalog version 1.0.7, checked 2026-11-14. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id1591340577)
- [ManYue: Comic Reader for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/manyue/index.md): Learn about ManYue comic imports, offline reading, WebDAV, SMB and personal comic servers, then choose a tutorial for your library. Product: ManYue / 漫阅+; internal content key: `man_yue`; catalog version 2.0.5, checked 2026-11-14. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6753895889)
- [VectorPaint: SVG Editor for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/vectorpaint/index.md): Create vector drawings and logos on iPhone and iPad. Learn VectorPaint shapes, Bézier nodes, SVG editing and image tracing, then export SVG, PNG or PDF. Product: VectorPaint; internal content key: `draw_illustration`; catalog version 1.0.8, checked 2026-11-14. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id1587272880)
- [Book Isle: Ebook Reader for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/nasbook/index.md): Learn about Book Isle local imports, WebDAV, SMB, OPDS, Calibre, notes and reading-data sync through a 180-tutorial learning path. Product: Book Isle / 书屿; internal content key: `nas_book`; catalog version 1.1.4, checked 2026-11-14. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6766198898)
- [iCouldPlay: Video Player for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/icouldplay/index.md): Learn about iCouldPlay local videos, SMB, WebDAV, FTP, media servers, subtitles and playback engines through 160 practical tutorials. Product: iCouldPlay / 云映; internal content key: `icouldplay`; catalog version 1.1.1, checked 2026-11-14. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6755653178)
- [Yearn: Retro Game Emulator for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/yearn/index.md): Learn about Yearn game imports, touch and physical controllers, save states, sync checks, display layouts and launch troubleshooting. Product: Yearn; internal content key: `yearn`; catalog version 1.0.2, checked 2026-10-23. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6756637059)
- [调调: Personal Music Player for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/diaodiao/index.md): Organise and play your own music with 调调, including file imports, Wi-Fi transfers, offline listening, lyrics, queues and compatible personal music servers. Product: 调调; internal content key: `diaodiao`; catalog version 1.0, checked 2026-11-14. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/%E8%B0%83%E8%B0%83-%E4%B8%AA%E4%BA%BA%E9%9F%B3%E4%B9%90%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%E5%99%A8/id6827171352?l=en-GB)
- [Jianlai (键来): Custom Keyboard for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/jianlai/index.md): Explore Jianlai themes, fonts, backgrounds and space-bar customisation, Chinese, English and Japanese input, 26-key and nine-key layouts, piano sounds and haptic feedback. Product: Jianlai / 键来; internal content key: `jianlai`; catalog version 1.0.5, checked 2026-11-14. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/fi/app/%E9%94%AE%E6%9D%A5/id6754281557)
